embeds.title: 🟡 Ghost CMS SQL Injection Flaw Exploited in Large-Scale ClickFix Campaign
embeds.description:
XLab threat intelligence researchers at Qianxin discovered a large-scale campaign exploiting CVE-2026-26980, a critical SQL injection vulnerability in Ghost CMS versions 3.24.0 through 6.19.0. The campaign injected malicious JavaScript code triggering ClickFix attacks on more than 700 domains, including Harvard University, Oxford University, Auburn University, and DuckDuckGo. Attackers stole admin API keys to inject malicious JavaScript loaders that served fake Cloudflare prompts instructing victims to execute commands, delivering payloads including DLL loaders, JavaScript droppers, and UtilifySetup.exe malware.
**Sources:** BleepingComputer • 🟢 4 corroborating
**CVEs:** CVE-2026-26980 • **Access:** SQL injection vulnerability in Ghost CMS
**Incident date:** unknown • **Confidence:** reported
